title: Noise-protected two-qubit gate using anisotropic exchange interaction
summary: Hole spin qubits hosted in Germanium quantum dots are promising candidates for scalable quantum computing. The strong spin-orbit interaction can enable fast and all-electrical quantum control. Furthermore, the platform can implement universal quantum control using only baseband signals, which may mitigate the impact of crosstalk and microwave-induced heating. At the same time, spin-orbit interaction gives rise to an anisotropic exchange interaction, whose potential for implementing two-qubit gates has remained largely unexplored.
